Recommended approach: a dedicated full-screen SearchView **pushed** onto the Home tab's NavigationStack (magnifier toolbar button → new ChirpRoute.search), native `.searchable` with auto-focus, and **all input disambiguation done by the Rust intent classifier** (new `classifyInput` facade method — never Swift regex). Free text runs live NIP-50 search (cache seeds instantly, relays tail in, reverse-chronological, per-row provenance chips); a recognized npub/nevent/naddr or a NIP-AD web URL raises a pinned "Open …" cell at the top that the user taps to navigate. Pushing (vs the removed sheet) is the key upgrade: thread/profile open on top of search and Back restores the results — the removed sheet had to dismiss-then-push and lost the query. Reuse NostrUserCard (profiles), ProfileNoteRow (notes, not NoteRowView — avoids a live-count subscription storm), ChirpPlaceholder (states); give every row one combined VoiceOver label (chirp#67).

Critical for the build agent: the NMP doorways all exist but the OLD C-ABI symbols never existed (that's why chirp#27 deleted search). They're **wireable in the app-owned nmp-app-chirp facade** — it already holds *mut NmpApp and depends on nmp-native-runtime/nmp-nip50/nmp-nostr-id — so the agent adds UniFFI methods (openSearch/classifyInput/resolveRef/resolveAd), not C-ABI. The removed SearchController/IntentWire (recovered from commit 1133250) is a near-perfect template. Three documented product gaps to file NMP issues for only if they matter: N50S has no relevance score (chronological only), naddr has no Chirp route (v1 → author profile), and no pagination cursor. NIP-AD resolves to a collection (0..N events), so the spec adds a small AdCollectionView. The comment has a full acceptance list mirroring the sweep's rigor.
